raw_content:
Harbourline Quay office sells for $388 per square foot

Harbourline Quay, a 210,000 square foot waterfront office building, sold for $388 per square foot in 2026. The new owner plans to refurbish two floors.

The building was 81 percent leased at the time of sale.

Harbourline Quay is a fictional property used in a software demonstration; this article was prepared for a software demonstration.
